model = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path('model_ref.xml')
data = mujoco.MjData(model)

# Check plugin info
print('nplugin:', model.nplugin)
p = model.plugin[0]
print(f'plugin[0]: {p}')
# Try to get plugin info via data
print(f'data.plugin: {data.plugin}')
print(f'data.plugin len: {len(data.plugin)}')
for i, pl in enumerate(data.plugin):
    print(f'  plugin[{i}]: {pl}')
print()
# Check plugin state
print('npluginstate:', model.npluginstate)
print('data.plugin_state len:', len(data.plugin_state))
print('data.plugin_state:', data.plugin_state)
print()
# Check plugin nstate
print('data.npluginstate:', data.npluginstate)
" 2>&1
